title: Coach
summary: An AI coach that reads the diary, remembers, and speaks up when it matters.
description: The coach is a chat on the Coach tab. Its knowledge is kept in separate pieces: the stance the user declares, the memory it keeps, manuals it writes, and a digest of the diary computed fresh every turn.

stories.as: someone trying to change a habit
stories.want: a coach that already knows how my week went
stories.soThat: I can ask it a question without explaining myself first

requirements.text: The stance (ranked imperatives, tone, length, language, notes and subjects never to raise) is set by the user and never edited by the coach.

history.text: The stance (ranked imperatives, tone, subjects never to raise) is set by the user and never edited by the coach.
history.reason: Version 1 left out length, language and notes.

requirements.text: The coach's memory (commitments, preferences, notes) is kept apart from chats: deleting a chat keeps it, and a new chat starts with it.
Every coach turn carries a digest of the diary computed at that moment.
A conversation has its own address, `/assistant/<chatId>`.
An entity id the coach writes in a message shows as a chip with that entity's title; where the entity has a screen, tapping the chip goes there.

history.text: An entity id the coach writes in a message shows as a chip with that entity's title, opening its page.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: some kinds (supplements, tags, saved meals, captures) have no screen.

requirements.text: Coach tools take ids in TypeID form and also accept the bare UUIDs and numbers older chats quote; an id of the wrong kind is refused with the reason.
`query_calories` names every calorie figure as one of eaten, burned_workouts, burned_total, target, net, remaining or energy_balance, and the coach is told to use it for calorie questions.

history.text: The coach never reads a bare "calories": every calorie figure it can query has one name (eaten, burned_workouts, burned_total, target, net, remaining, energy_balance).
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: other tools and the digest still show raw calorie fields.

requirements.text: The memory is shown on a page the user can read.
